```{r}
# Load packages
library(terra)
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
```


# code to save the areas in all confidence levels and in all marine zones (summary tables) corrected in July 2025
```{r}
# Create output directory
output_dir <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Analysis_2024_Corrected")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# 1.  Create bbox in Albers
bbox_albers <- st_bbox(c(xmin = 140.995, xmax = 153.005, ymin = -47.255, ymax = -38.995)) %>%
  st_as_sfc() %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  st_set_crs(4326) %>%
  st_transform(3577)

#2. Load and process all required data


maritime_boundaries_AU<- st_read(here("raw_data/AU_GA_SSLA-1973-AMB2014a_Maritime_boundaries_Australia/AU_GA_SSLA_1973_AMB2014a_ts_1990_poly.shp"))%>%
 st_transform("EPSG:3577")%>%
 st_make_valid()

coastal_waters <- st_read(here("raw_data/Coastal_Waters_areas_(AMB2020)/Coastal_Waters_areas_(AMB2020).shp"))%>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577")%>%
  st_make_valid()

commonwealth_waters <- st_read(here("raw_data/Commonwealth_Marine_Regions/Commonwealth_Marine_Regions.shp")) %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577")%>%
  st_make_valid()

terrestrial_areas <- st_read(here("raw_data/AustralianStates_SHP/STE_2021_AUST_GDA2020.shp")) %>%
  st_transform("EPSG:3577")%>%
  st_make_valid()

# 3. Crop all layers to bbox

terrestrial_areas_crop <- st_intersection(terrestrial_areas, bbox_albers)
coastal_waters_crop <- st_intersection(coastal_waters, bbox_albers)
commonwealth_crop <- st_intersection(commonwealth_waters, bbox_albers)
maritime_boundaries_crop<-st_intersection(maritime_boundaries_AU,bbox_albers)


state_waters<-st_difference(coastal_waters_crop, st_union(terrestrial_areas_crop))


# 4. Create High Seas
all_managed_waters_and_land <- bind_rows(
  st_set_geometry(commonwealth_crop, "geometry") %>% mutate(zone_type = "Commonwealth"),
  st_set_geometry(state_waters, "geometry") %>% mutate(zone_type = "State"),
  st_set_geometry(terrestrial_areas_crop, "geometry") %>% mutate(zone_type = "terrestrial_areas")
)

high_seas <- st_difference(bbox_albers, st_union(all_managed_waters_and_land))

# Define marine zones using the corrected approach
marine_zones <- list(
  "State Waters" = state_waters,
  "Commonwealth Waters" = commonwealth_crop,
  "High Seas" = high_seas
)

# Initialize results dataframe
area_results_marine <- data.frame(
  SSP = character(),
  Decade = character(),
  Pattern = character(),
  Marine_Zone = character(),
  No_Analog_km2 = numeric(),
  Low_Confidence_km2 = numeric(),
  Medium_Confidence_km2 = numeric(),
  High_Confidence_km2 = numeric(),
  Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 = numeric(),
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)

# Define path to the combined MSP folder
msp_folder <- here("output_data", "Climate_MSP_Constraints_2024")

# Define patterns
patterns <- c("suitable", "optimal")

# Load the constraints raster
constraints_path <- here("output_data", "Constraints_2024", "total_constraints.tif")
constraints_raster <- rast(constraints_path)

# Process each pattern (keeping your existing loop structure)
for (pattern in patterns) {
  cat("\nProcessing pattern:", pattern, "\n")
  
  # Get all combined MSP files for this pattern
  pattern_folder <- file.path(msp_folder, pattern)
  msp_files <- list.files(pattern_folder, pattern = "\\.tif$", full.names = TRUE)
  
  cat("Found", length(msp_files), "files for pattern:", pattern, "\n")
  
  for (msp_file in msp_files) {
    tryCatch({
      # Extract filename info (keeping your existing parsing)
      msp_filename <- basename(msp_file)
      cat("Processing file:", msp_filename, "\n")
      
      # Extract SSP and decade info from filename
      parts <- strsplit(msp_filename, "_")[[1]]
      ssp_idx <- which(grepl("^ssp", parts))[1]
      ssp <- parts[ssp_idx]
      decade_start <- parts[ssp_idx+1]
      decade_end <- parts[ssp_idx+2]
      decade_range <- paste(decade_start, decade_end, sep = "_")
      
      cat("SSP:", ssp, "- Decade:", decade_range, "\n")
      
      # Load MSP raster
      msp_rast <- rast(msp_file)
      
      # Ensure projection is EPSG:3577
      if (crs(msp_rast) != "EPSG:3577") {
        msp_rast <- project(msp_rast, "EPSG:3577")
      }
      
      # Create area raster
      area_raster <- cellSize(msp_rast, unit = "m")
      
      # Calculate areas for each climate category (keeping your existing approach)
      no_analog_area <- as.numeric(global(area_raster * (msp_rast == 0), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
      low_conf_area <- as.numeric(global(area_raster * (msp_rast == 1), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
      medium_conf_area <- as.numeric(global(area_raster * (msp_rast == 2), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
      high_conf_area <- as.numeric(global(area_raster * (msp_rast == 3), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
      
      # Resample constraints to match MSP resolution
      constraints_aligned <- resample(constraints_raster, msp_rast)
      
      # Create constraint-unsuitable mask
      constraint_mask <- (constraints_aligned == 0 | is.na(constraints_aligned))
      constraint_mask[is.na(constraint_mask)] <- FALSE
      
      # Calculate constraint-unsuitable area
      constraint_area <- as.numeric(global(area_raster * constraint_mask, sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
      
      cat("Total suitable area (km²):", no_analog_area + low_conf_area + medium_conf_area + high_conf_area, "\n")
      cat("Areas by category (km²):\n")
      cat("  No Analog:", no_analog_area, "\n")
      cat("  Low Confidence:", low_conf_area, "\n")
      cat("  Medium Confidence:", medium_conf_area, "\n")
      cat("  High Confidence:", high_conf_area, "\n")
      cat("  Unsuitable (Constraints):", constraint_area, "\n")
      
      # Process each marine zone using the pre-defined polygons
      for (zone_name in names(marine_zones)) {
        zone_vect <- vect(marine_zones[[zone_name]])
        
        # Mask all rasters with the zone
        zone_msp <- mask(msp_rast, zone_vect)
        zone_area <- mask(area_raster, zone_vect)
        zone_constraint <- mask(constraint_mask, zone_vect)
        
        # Calculate areas by category
        zone_no_analog <- as.numeric(global(zone_area * (zone_msp == 0), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
        zone_low_conf <- as.numeric(global(zone_area * (zone_msp == 1), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
        zone_medium_conf <- as.numeric(global(zone_area * (zone_msp == 2), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
        zone_high_conf <- as.numeric(global(zone_area * (zone_msp == 3), sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
        zone_constraint_area <- as.numeric(global(zone_area * zone_constraint, sum, na.rm = TRUE)) / 1e6
        
        # Replace NAs with 0
        zone_no_analog <- ifelse(is.na(zone_no_analog), 0, zone_no_analog)
        zone_low_conf <- ifelse(is.na(zone_low_conf), 0, zone_low_conf)
        zone_medium_conf <- ifelse(is.na(zone_medium_conf), 0, zone_medium_conf)
        zone_high_conf <- ifelse(is.na(zone_high_conf), 0, zone_high_conf)
        zone_constraint_area <- ifelse(is.na(zone_constraint_area), 0, zone_constraint_area)
        
        # Add to results
        area_results_marine <- rbind(area_results_marine, data.frame(
          SSP = ssp,
          Decade = decade_range,
          Pattern = pattern,
          Marine_Zone = zone_name,
          No_Analog_km2 = zone_no_analog,
          Low_Confidence_km2 = zone_low_conf,
          Medium_Confidence_km2 = zone_medium_conf,
          High_Confidence_km2 = zone_high_conf,
          Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 = zone_constraint_area
        ))
        
        # Debug output for each zone
        if (zone_name == "High Seas") {
          cat("High Seas areas (km²) for", ssp, decade_range, pattern, ":\n")
          cat("  No Analog:", zone_no_analog, "\n")
          cat("  Low Confidence:", zone_low_conf, "\n")
          cat("  Medium Confidence:", zone_medium_conf, "\n")
          cat("  High Confidence:", zone_high_conf, "\n")
          cat("  Unsuitable (Constraints):", zone_constraint_area, "\n")
        }
      }
      
      # Save intermediate results
      write.csv(area_results_marine, 
                file.path(output_dir, "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"), 
                row.names = FALSE)
      
    }, error = function(e) {
      cat("ERROR processing file:", msp_file, "\n")
      cat("Error message:", e$message, "\n")
    })
  }
}

# Create summary and visualizations
if (nrow(area_results_marine) > 0) {
  # Create summary table
  summary_table <- area_results_marine %>%
    group_by(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Marine_Zone) %>%
    summarise(
      Total_Area_km2 = sum(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
                         High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      No_Analog_pct = No_Analog_km2 / Total_Area_km2 * 100,
      Low_Confidence_pct = Low_Confidence_km2 / Total_Area_km2 * 100,
      Medium_Confidence_pct = Medium_Confidence_km2 / Total_Area_km2 * 100,
      High_Confidence_pct = High_Confidence_km2 / Total_Area_km2 * 100,
      Unsuitable_Constraints_pct = Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 / Total_Area_km2 * 100,
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Save summary table
  write.csv(summary_table, 
            file.path(output_dir, "summary_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"), 
            row.names = FALSE)
  
  cat("Analysis complete. Results saved to:", output_dir, "\n")
 
}
```

#plots
```{r}
# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

# Load the CORRECTED results data
results_path <- file.path(output_dir, "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv")
area_results <- read.csv(results_path)

# Create output directory for corrected plots
plots_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Set a consistent theme for all plots
my_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Calculate the sum of suitable (low + medium + high confidence) areas
area_results <- area_results %>%
  mutate(
    Climate_Suitable_km2 = Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2
  )

# 1. RECREATE ORIGINAL PLOTS FROM YOUR CODE
# Create plots for each SSP and pattern (matching your original structure)
for (curr_ssp in unique(area_results$SSP)) {
  for (curr_pattern in unique(area_results$Pattern)) {
    # Filter data
    plot_data <- area_results %>%
      filter(SSP == curr_ssp, Pattern == curr_pattern) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
               High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2),
        names_to = "Category",
        values_to = "Area_km2"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Category = case_when(
          Category == "No_Analog_km2" ~ "No Analog",
          Category == "Low_Confidence_km2" ~ "Low Confidence",
          Category == "Medium_Confidence_km2" ~ "Medium Confidence",
          Category == "High_Confidence_km2" ~ "High Confidence",
          Category == "Unsuitable_Constraints_km2" ~ "Unsuitable (Constraints)",
          TRUE ~ Category
        ),
        Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
          "High Confidence", "Medium Confidence", "Low Confidence", 
          "No Analog", "Unsuitable (Constraints)"
        ))
      )
    
    # Create area plot (matching your original)
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, direction = -1) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Area by Climate Suitability and Constraints -", 
                     curr_ssp, "-", curr_pattern),
        x = "Time Period",
        y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
        fill = "Category"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    # Save plot
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, paste0("area_plot_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")),
      p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
    
    # Create percentage plot (matching your original)
    p_pct <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
      facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone) +
      scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, direction = -1) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Percentage by Climate Suitability and Constraints -", 
                     curr_ssp, "-", curr_pattern),
        x = "Time Period",
        y = "Percentage",
        fill = "Category"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    # Save percentage plot
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, paste0("area_plot_pct_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")),
      p_pct, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# 2. RECREATE HIGH CONFIDENCE TREND PLOTS
for (curr_pattern in unique(area_results$Pattern)) {
  for (curr_ssp in unique(area_results$SSP)) {
    # Filter data
    high_conf_data <- area_results %>%
      filter(Pattern == curr_pattern, SSP == curr_ssp) %>%
      mutate(Decade_num = as.numeric(substr(gsub("_.*", "", Decade), 1, 4))) %>%
      arrange(Decade_num) %>%
      mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade)))
    
    # Trend line plot
    p1 <- ggplot(high_conf_data, aes(x = Decade, y = High_Confidence_km2, 
                                   group = Marine_Zone, color = Marine_Zone)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      scale_color_viridis_d() +
      labs(
        title = paste("High Confidence Areas Through Time -", curr_ssp, "-", curr_pattern),
        subtitle = "Tracking potential aquaculture suitability across decades",
        x = "Time Period",
        y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
        color = "Marine Zone"
      ) +
      my_theme
    
    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, paste0("high_confidence_trend_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")),
      p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# 3. RECREATE CONSTRAINT OVERLAY PLOTS
for (curr_zone in unique(area_results$Marine_Zone)) {
  # First check if there's any data
  zone_data <- area_results %>% 
    filter(Marine_Zone == curr_zone)
  
  if (nrow(zone_data) == 0) next
  
  # Get the constraint area - should be the same for all decades since constraints don't change
  constraint_area <- zone_data %>%
    group_by(Pattern) %>%
    summarize(
      Avg_Constraint_Area = mean(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  plot_data <- zone_data %>%
    select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Climate_Suitable_km2) %>%
    # Convert to numeric decade for proper ordering
    mutate(Decade_num = as.numeric(gsub("_.*", "", Decade))) %>%
    arrange(Decade_num) %>%
    # Create a factor with proper ordering
    mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade)))
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Climate_Suitable_km2, fill = Pattern)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    geom_hline(
      data = constraint_area,
      aes(yintercept = Avg_Constraint_Area, linetype = Pattern),
      color = "red", size = 1.2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~SSP, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("suitable" = "#21918c", "optimal" = "#440154"),
      labels = c("suitable" = "Suitable Pattern", "optimal" = "Optimal Pattern"),
      name = "Pattern"
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("suitable" = "solid", "optimal" = "dashed"),
      labels = c(
        "suitable" = "Constraint-Unsuitable Area (Suitable Pattern)",
        "optimal" = "Constraint-Unsuitable Area (Optimal Pattern)"
      ),
      name = "Constraints"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Climate-Suitable Areas with Constraint Reference\n", curr_zone),
      subtitle = "Red lines show the constant constraint-unsuitable area",
      x = "Time Period",
      y = expression("Area (km"^2*")")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Save the plot
  filename <- paste0("climate_vs_constraints_", gsub(" ", "_", curr_zone), ".png")
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir, filename),
    p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
  )
}

# 4. RECREATE STACKED BAR CHARTS
for (curr_pattern in unique(area_results$Pattern)) {
  for (curr_ssp in unique(area_results$SSP)) {
    # Prepare data - aggregate across all zones
    plot_data <- area_results %>%
      filter(Pattern == curr_pattern, SSP == curr_ssp) %>%
      group_by(Decade, Marine_Zone) %>%
      summarize(
        Climate_Suitable_km2 = sum(Climate_Suitable_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 = sum(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        No_Analog_km2 = sum(No_Analog_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      # Convert to long format
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(Climate_Suitable_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, No_Analog_km2),
        names_to = "Category",
        values_to = "Area_km2"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Category = case_when(
          Category == "Climate_Suitable_km2" ~ "Climate Suitable",
          Category == "Unsuitable_Constraints_km2" ~ "Constraint-Unsuitable",
          Category == "No_Analog_km2" ~ "No Climate Analog",
          TRUE ~ Category
        ),
        # Order categories for stacking
        Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
          "Climate Suitable", "No Climate Analog", "Constraint-Unsuitable"
        )),
        # Convert to numeric decade for proper ordering
        Decade_num = as.numeric(gsub("_.*", "", Decade))
      ) %>%
      arrange(Decade_num) %>%
      # Create factor for proper ordering
      mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade)))
    
    # Create stacked bar chart
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "Climate Suitable" = "#21918c",
          "No Climate Analog" = "#440154",
          "Constraint-Unsuitable" = "#fde725"
        ),
        name = "Category"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Area Breakdown by Category\n", curr_ssp, " - ", curr_pattern, " Pattern"),
        subtitle = "Note: Constraint-Unsuitable area is constant over time",
        x = "Time Period",
        y = expression("Area (km"^2*")")
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
      )
    
    # Save the plot
    filename <- paste0("stacked_bar_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, filename),
      p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# 5. RECREATE CONSTRAINT IMPACT ANALYSIS
# Calculate constraint-unsuitable area by marine zone
constraint_area_by_zone <- area_results %>%
  # Group by marine zone and pattern
  group_by(Marine_Zone, Pattern) %>%
  # Calculate average constraint area (should be constant across time periods)
  summarize(
    Constraint_Unsuitable_km2 = mean(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Check if it's truly constant by calculating standard deviation
    Constraint_StdDev = sd(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Order by marine zone
  arrange(Marine_Zone, Pattern)

# Save constraint area summary
write.csv(constraint_area_by_zone, 
          file.path(plots_dir, "constraint_area_by_zone_CORRECTED.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Create constraint area plot
constraint_plot <- ggplot(constraint_area_by_zone, 
                       aes(x = Marine_Zone, y = Constraint_Unsuitable_km2, fill = Pattern)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal Pattern", "suitable" = "Suitable Pattern"),
    end = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Area Unsuitable Due to Constraints by Marine Zone",
    subtitle = "Comparing optimal and suitable patterns",
    x = "",
    y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
    fill = "Pattern"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Save the constraint plot
ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "constraint_area_by_zone_plot_CORRECTED.png"),
  constraint_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

# 6. RECREATE NET AVAILABILITY HEATMAP
# Calculate net availability
net_availability <- area_results %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate net availability (can be negative if constraints > high confidence)
    Net_Available_km2 = High_Confidence_km2 - Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    # Convert to percentage of total zone area
    Total_Zone_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + 
                         High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    Net_Available_Pct = Net_Available_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
    # Add categorical variable for easier interpretation
    Availability_Status = case_when(
      Net_Available_km2 > 0 ~ "Net Positive",
      Net_Available_km2 < 0 ~ "Net Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    )
  )

# Save net availability analysis
write.csv(net_availability, 
          file.path(plots_dir, "net_availability_analysis_CORRECTED.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)
          
```


#make figures and summaries
```{r}
# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(viridis)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(here)

# Load the CORRECTED results data
results_path <- file.path(output_dir, "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv")
area_results <- read.csv(results_path)

# Create output directory for corrected plots
plots_dir <- file.path(output_dir, "plots")
dir.create(plots_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Set a consistent theme for all plots
my_theme <- theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    text = element_text(family = "sans", size = 12),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom",
    legend.title = element_text(size = 10),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 11),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

# Calculate the sum of suitable (low + medium + high confidence) areas
area_results <- area_results %>%
  mutate(
    Climate_Suitable_km2 = Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2
  )

# 1. RECREATE ORIGINAL PLOTS FROM YOUR CODE
# Create plots for each SSP and pattern (matching your original structure)
for (curr_ssp in unique(area_results$SSP)) {
  for (curr_pattern in unique(area_results$Pattern)) {
    # Filter data
    plot_data <- area_results %>%
      filter(SSP == curr_ssp, Pattern == curr_pattern) %>%
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
               High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2),
        names_to = "Category",
        values_to = "Area_km2"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Category = case_when(
          Category == "No_Analog_km2" ~ "No Analog",
          Category == "Low_Confidence_km2" ~ "Low Confidence",
          Category == "Medium_Confidence_km2" ~ "Medium Confidence",
          Category == "High_Confidence_km2" ~ "High Confidence",
          Category == "Unsuitable_Constraints_km2" ~ "Unsuitable (Constraints)",
          TRUE ~ Category
        ),
        Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
          "High Confidence", "Medium Confidence", "Low Confidence", 
          "No Analog", "Unsuitable (Constraints)"
        ))
      )
    
    # Create area plot (matching your original)
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, direction = -1) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Area by Climate Suitability and Constraints -", 
                     curr_ssp, "-", curr_pattern),
        x = "Time Period",
        y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
        fill = "Category"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    # Save plot
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, paste0("area_plot_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")),
      p, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
    
    # Create percentage plot (matching your original)
    p_pct <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
      facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone) +
      scale_fill_viridis(discrete = TRUE, direction = -1) +
      scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
      labs(
        title = paste("Percentage by Climate Suitability and Constraints -", 
                     curr_ssp, "-", curr_pattern),
        x = "Time Period",
        y = "Percentage",
        fill = "Category"
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        legend.position = "bottom"
      )
    
    # Save percentage plot
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, paste0("area_plot_pct_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")),
      p_pct, width = 10, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# 2. RECREATE HIGH CONFIDENCE TREND PLOTS
for (curr_pattern in unique(area_results$Pattern)) {
  for (curr_ssp in unique(area_results$SSP)) {
    # Filter data
    high_conf_data <- area_results %>%
      filter(Pattern == curr_pattern, SSP == curr_ssp) %>%
      mutate(Decade_num = as.numeric(substr(gsub("_.*", "", Decade), 1, 4))) %>%
      arrange(Decade_num) %>%
      mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade)))
    
    # Trend line plot
    p1 <- ggplot(high_conf_data, aes(x = Decade, y = High_Confidence_km2, 
                                   group = Marine_Zone, color = Marine_Zone)) +
      geom_line(size = 1.2) +
      geom_point(size = 3) +
      scale_color_viridis_d() +
      labs(
        title = paste("High Confidence Areas Through Time -", curr_ssp, "-", curr_pattern),
        subtitle = "Tracking potential aquaculture suitability across decades",
        x = "Time Period",
        y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
        color = "Marine Zone"
      ) +
      my_theme
    
    # Save the plot
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, paste0("high_confidence_trend_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")),
      p1, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# 3. RECREATE CONSTRAINT OVERLAY PLOTS
for (curr_zone in unique(area_results$Marine_Zone)) {
  # First check if there's any data
  zone_data <- area_results %>% 
    filter(Marine_Zone == curr_zone)
  
  if (nrow(zone_data) == 0) next
  
  # Get the constraint area - should be the same for all decades since constraints don't change
  constraint_area <- zone_data %>%
    group_by(Pattern) %>%
    summarize(
      Avg_Constraint_Area = mean(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  # Prepare data for plotting
  plot_data <- zone_data %>%
    select(SSP, Decade, Pattern, Climate_Suitable_km2) %>%
    # Convert to numeric decade for proper ordering
    mutate(Decade_num = as.numeric(gsub("_.*", "", Decade))) %>%
    arrange(Decade_num) %>%
    # Create a factor with proper ordering
    mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade)))
  
  # Create the plot
  p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Climate_Suitable_km2, fill = Pattern)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
    geom_hline(
      data = constraint_area,
      aes(yintercept = Avg_Constraint_Area, linetype = Pattern),
      color = "red", size = 1.2
    ) +
    facet_wrap(~SSP, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(
      values = c("suitable" = "#21918c", "optimal" = "#440154"),
      labels = c("suitable" = "Suitable Pattern", "optimal" = "Optimal Pattern"),
      name = "Pattern"
    ) +
    scale_linetype_manual(
      values = c("suitable" = "solid", "optimal" = "dashed"),
      labels = c(
        "suitable" = "Constraint-Unsuitable Area (Suitable Pattern)",
        "optimal" = "Constraint-Unsuitable Area (Optimal Pattern)"
      ),
      name = "Constraints"
    ) +
    labs(
      title = paste0("Climate-Suitable Areas with Constraint Reference\n", curr_zone),
      subtitle = "Red lines show the constant constraint-unsuitable area",
      x = "Time Period",
      y = expression("Area (km"^2*")")
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
      axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
      panel.grid.major = element_line(color = "gray90"),
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
    )
  
  # Save the plot
  filename <- paste0("climate_vs_constraints_", gsub(" ", "_", curr_zone), ".png")
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir, filename),
    p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
  )
}

# 4. RECREATE STACKED BAR CHARTS
for (curr_pattern in unique(area_results$Pattern)) {
  for (curr_ssp in unique(area_results$SSP)) {
    # Prepare data - aggregate across all zones
    plot_data <- area_results %>%
      filter(Pattern == curr_pattern, SSP == curr_ssp) %>%
      group_by(Decade, Marine_Zone) %>%
      summarize(
        Climate_Suitable_km2 = sum(Climate_Suitable_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 = sum(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        No_Analog_km2 = sum(No_Analog_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
        .groups = "drop"
      ) %>%
      # Convert to long format
      pivot_longer(
        cols = c(Climate_Suitable_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, No_Analog_km2),
        names_to = "Category",
        values_to = "Area_km2"
      ) %>%
      mutate(
        Category = case_when(
          Category == "Climate_Suitable_km2" ~ "Climate Suitable",
          Category == "Unsuitable_Constraints_km2" ~ "Constraint-Unsuitable",
          Category == "No_Analog_km2" ~ "No Climate Analog",
          TRUE ~ Category
        ),
        # Order categories for stacking
        Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
          "Climate Suitable", "No Climate Analog", "Constraint-Unsuitable"
        )),
        # Convert to numeric decade for proper ordering
        Decade_num = as.numeric(gsub("_.*", "", Decade))
      ) %>%
      arrange(Decade_num) %>%
      # Create factor for proper ordering
      mutate(Decade = factor(Decade, levels = unique(Decade)))
    
    # Create stacked bar chart
    p <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
      geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
      facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y") +
      scale_fill_manual(
        values = c(
          "Climate Suitable" = "#21918c",
          "No Climate Analog" = "#440154",
          "Constraint-Unsuitable" = "#fde725"
        ),
        name = "Category"
      ) +
      labs(
        title = paste0("Area Breakdown by Category\n", curr_ssp, " - ", curr_pattern, " Pattern"),
        subtitle = "Note: Constraint-Unsuitable area is constant over time",
        x = "Time Period",
        y = expression("Area (km"^2*")")
      ) +
      theme_minimal() +
      theme(
        legend.position = "bottom",
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
        axis.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold")
      )
    
    # Save the plot
    filename <- paste0("stacked_bar_", curr_ssp, "_", curr_pattern, ".png")
    ggsave(
      file.path(plots_dir, filename),
      p, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
    )
  }
}

# 5. RECREATE CONSTRAINT IMPACT ANALYSIS
# Calculate constraint-unsuitable area by marine zone
constraint_area_by_zone <- area_results %>%
  # Group by marine zone and pattern
  group_by(Marine_Zone, Pattern) %>%
  # Calculate average constraint area (should be constant across time periods)
  summarize(
    Constraint_Unsuitable_km2 = mean(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    # Check if it's truly constant by calculating standard deviation
    Constraint_StdDev = sd(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Order by marine zone
  arrange(Marine_Zone, Pattern)

# Save constraint area summary
write.csv(constraint_area_by_zone, 
          file.path(plots_dir, "constraint_area_by_zone_CORRECTED.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Create constraint area plot
constraint_plot <- ggplot(constraint_area_by_zone, 
                       aes(x = Marine_Zone, y = Constraint_Unsuitable_km2, fill = Pattern)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = position_dodge(width = 0.9)) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d(
    labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal Pattern", "suitable" = "Suitable Pattern"),
    end = 0.8
  ) +
  labs(
    title = "Area Unsuitable Due to Constraints by Marine Zone",
    subtitle = "Comparing optimal and suitable patterns",
    x = "",
    y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
    fill = "Pattern"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )

# Save the constraint plot
ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "constraint_area_by_zone_plot_CORRECTED.png"),
  constraint_plot, width = 10, height = 6, dpi = 300
)

# 6. RECREATE NET AVAILABILITY HEATMAP
# Calculate net availability
net_availability <- area_results %>%
  mutate(
    # Calculate net availability (can be negative if constraints > high confidence)
    Net_Available_km2 = High_Confidence_km2 - Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    # Convert to percentage of total zone area
    Total_Zone_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + 
                         High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    Net_Available_Pct = Net_Available_km2 / Total_Zone_Area_km2 * 100,
    # Add categorical variable for easier interpretation
    Availability_Status = case_when(
      Net_Available_km2 > 0 ~ "Net Positive",
      Net_Available_km2 < 0 ~ "Net Negative",
      TRUE ~ "Neutral"
    )
  )

# Save net availability analysis
write.csv(net_availability, 
          file.path(plots_dir, "net_availability_analysis_CORRECTED.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Create heatmap of net availability
p_heatmap <- ggplot(net_availability, 
                  aes(x = Decade, y = Marine_Zone, fill = Net_Available_Pct)) +
  geom_tile() +
  # Use a diverging color palette centered at zero
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "#d73027", 
    mid = "#f7f7f7", 
    high = "#1a9850", 
    midpoint = 0,
    name = "Net Available (%)"
  ) +
  # Facet by SSP and Pattern
  facet_grid(Pattern ~ SSP, labeller = labeller(
    Pattern = c("optimal" = "Optimal Pattern", "suitable" = "Suitable Pattern")
  )) +
  labs(
    title = "Net High Confidence Area Availability After Constraints",
    subtitle = "Green = positive net availability, Red = negative (constraints exceed high confidence area)",
    x = "Time Period",
    y = "Marine Zone"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1, size = 8),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Save the heatmap
ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "net_availability_heatmap_CORRECTED.png"),
  p_heatmap, width = 14, height = 10, dpi = 300
)

# 7. RECREATE TIPPING POINT ANALYSIS
# Calculate tipping points
tipping_point <- net_availability %>%
  # Create indicators for availability status
  mutate(
    Is_Net_Negative = Net_Available_km2 < 0
  ) %>%
  # Group by marine zone, SSP, and pattern
  group_by(Marine_Zone, SSP, Pattern) %>%
  # Find the first decade where net availability becomes negative
  summarize(
    Tipping_Point_Decade = first(Decade[Is_Net_Negative]),
    # If always positive, indicate "Never"
    Tipping_Point_Decade = ifelse(is.na(Tipping_Point_Decade), "Never", Tipping_Point_Decade),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  # Order for better visualization
  arrange(Marine_Zone, SSP, Pattern)

# Save tipping point analysis
write.csv(tipping_point, 
          file.path(plots_dir, "tipping_point_analysis_CORRECTED.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

# Create a factor for the decade to control the color order
decade_order <- c("2021_2030", "2031_2040", "2041_2050", "2051_2060", 
                 "2061_2070", "2071_2080", "2081_2090", "2091_2100", "Never")

tipping_point$Tipping_Point_Decade <- factor(tipping_point$Tipping_Point_Decade, 
                                           levels = decade_order)

# Create tipping point visualization
p_tipping <- ggplot(tipping_point, 
                  aes(x = SSP, y = Marine_Zone, fill = Tipping_Point_Decade)) +
  geom_tile() +
  geom_text(aes(label = as.character(Tipping_Point_Decade)), 
            color = "black", size = 3) +
  facet_wrap(~Pattern, labeller = labeller(
    Pattern = c("optimal" = "Optimal Pattern", "suitable" = "Suitable Pattern")
  )) +
  scale_fill_viridis_d() +
  labs(
    title = "Tipping Point Analysis: When Constraints Exceed High Confidence Area",
    subtitle = "'Never' indicates high confidence area always exceeds constraints",
    x = "Climate Scenario",
    y = "Marine Zone",
    fill = "Tipping Point\nDecade"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 14),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.major = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank()
  )

# Save the tipping point visualization
ggsave(
  file.path(plots_dir, "tipping_point_visualization_CORRECTED.png"),
  p_tipping, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
)

# Generate an HTML report
html_report <- paste0(
  "<!DOCTYPE html>
  <html>
  <head>
    <title>Marine Aquaculture Climate and Constraints Analysis - CORRECTED</title>
    <style>
      body {font-family: Arial, sans-serif; margin: 20px; max-width: 1200px; margin: 0 auto;}
      h1 {color: #2c3e50; border-bottom: 2px solid #3498db; padding-bottom: 10px;}
      h2 {color: #2c3e50; margin-top: 30px;}
      .plot-container {margin: 20px 0; padding: 10px; border: 1px solid #ddd; border-radius: 5px;}
      .plot-img {max-width: 100%; height: auto;}
      .caption {font-style: italic; color: #555; margin-top: 5px;}
      .section {margin-top: 40px;}
    </style>
  </head>
  <body>
    <h1>Marine Aquaculture Climate and Constraints Analysis</h1>
    <p>This report presents visualizations of potential marine aquaculture areas based on climate suitability and spatial constraints, with corrected High Seas calculations.</p>
    
    <div class='section'>
      <h2>Area Breakdown by Climate Suitability and Constraints</h2>
      <p>These plots show the breakdown of areas by climate category and constraints across marine zones.</p>
    </div>
    
    <div class='section'>
      <h2>Net High Confidence Area Availability</h2>
      <div class='plot-container'>
        <img class='plot-img' src='net_availability_heatmap_CORRECTED.png' alt='Net Availability Heatmap'>
        <p class='caption'>Net availability of high confidence areas after accounting for constraints.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
    
    <div class='section'>
      <h2>Tipping Point Analysis</h2>
      <div class='plot-container'>
        <img class='plot-img' src='tipping_point_visualization_CORRECTED.png' alt='Tipping Point Analysis'>
        <p class='caption'>When constraints start to exceed high confidence areas.</p>
      </div>
    </div>
  </body>
  </html>"
)

# Write the HTML report
writeLines(html_report, file.path(plots_dir, "analysis_report_CORRECTED.html"))

cat("All plots recreated with corrected data. Results saved to:", plots_dir, "\n")

```

```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(here)

# Read the CORRECTED dataset
data2 <- read_csv(file.path(output_dir, "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))

# Let's examine the structure of corrected data2
print("Corrected Data2 structure:")
print(head(data2))
print("Unique columns in corrected data2:")
print(colnames(data2))

# Data preparation for corrected data2
plot_data2 <- data2 %>%
  # Clean up marine zone names for better display AND set factor order
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone_Clean = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "State Waters" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Set the factor order for Marine_Zone to control facet arrangement
    Marine_Zone_Clean = factor(Marine_Zone_Clean, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    # Clean up SSP names
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5", 
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    ),
    # Create a year variable for x-axis (use decade midpoint for plotting)
    Year = case_when(
      Decade == "2021_2030" ~ 2025,
      Decade == "2031_2040" ~ 2035,
      Decade == "2041_2050" ~ 2045,
      Decade == "2051_2060" ~ 2055,
      Decade == "2061_2070" ~ 2065,
      Decade == "2071_2080" ~ 2075,
      Decade == "2081_2090" ~ 2085,
      Decade == "2091_2100" ~ 2095,
      TRUE ~ NA_real_
    ),
    # Calculate total area and constraint percentage
    Total_Area_km2 = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    # Available area is High_Confidence (this should be the free area after constraints)
    Free_Area_km2 = High_Confidence_km2,
    # Constrained area
    Constraint_Area_km2 = Unsuitable_Constraints_km2
  ) %>%
  select(SSP_clean, Year, Pattern, Marine_Zone_Clean, Free_Area_km2, Constraint_Area_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2)

# Current aquaculture usage
current_usage <- 25.88

# Create the main plot using corrected data only
p2_corrected <- ggplot(plot_data2, aes(x = Year)) +
  # Show constraint area as ribbon from 0 to constraint level
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = 0, ymax = Constraint_Area_km2), 
              fill = "gray80", alpha = 0.7, 
              data = plot_data2 %>% 
                filter(Pattern == "suitable") %>%
                group_by(Marine_Zone_Clean, Year) %>%
                slice(1)) +  # Only show once per year per zone
  
  # Add lines for available area (High_Confidence) - dashed for suitable, solid for optimal
  geom_line(aes(y = Free_Area_km2, color = SSP_clean, linetype = Pattern), size = 1) +
  
  # Add horizontal line for current aquaculture usage at 25.88 km²
  geom_hline(yintercept = current_usage, 
             color = "#E7298A", # Magenta from colorbrewer (colorblind-friendly)
             linetype = "dotted", 
             size = 0.8,
             alpha = 0.9) +
  
  # Facet by marine zone (will now show in order: State Waters, Commonwealth Waters, High Seas)
  facet_wrap(~ Marine_Zone_Clean, scales = "free_y", ncol = 1) +
  
  # Customize line types
  scale_linetype_manual(values = c("optimal" = "solid", "suitable" = "dashed"),
                       name = "Climate Analogue Type",
                       labels = c("optimal" = "Optimal", "suitable" = "Suitable")) +
  
  # Customize colors for SSP scenarios using the same viridis colors as your reference plot
  scale_color_manual(values = c("SSP1-1.9" = "#440154FF",   # Purple
                               "SSP1-2.6" = "#31688EFF",    # Blue 
                               "SSP2-4.5" = "#35B779FF",    # Teal/Green
                               "SSP3-7.0" = "#90D743FF",    # Light Green
                               "SSP5-8.5" = "#FDE725FF"),   # Yellow
                    name = "SSP Scenario") +
  
  # Axis labels and title
  labs(
    x = "Decade",
    y = expression("Area (km²)"),
    title = "Climate Analogues: Available Area with Constraints",
    subtitle = "Gray area = Constraints; Magenta dotted line = Current usage (25.88 km²)",
    caption = "Solid lines = Optimal analogues, Dashed lines = Suitable analogues"
  ) +
  
  # Theme customization
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.subtitle = element_text(size = 11, color = "gray40"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 12),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 10),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    legend.text = element_text(size = 10),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 11, face = "bold"),
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    plot.caption = element_text(size = 9, color = "gray50")
  ) +
  
  # Adjust x-axis to show decade labels properly
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2025, 2095, 10),
                    labels = c("2021-2030", "2031-2040", "2041-2050", "2051-2060", 
                              "2061-2070", "2071-2080", "2081-2090", "2091-2100")) +
  
  # Rotate x-axis labels for better readability
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))

# Display the corrected plot
print(p2_corrected)

# Show constraint levels summary for corrected data
print("Constraint summary in corrected data (2021-2030, suitable pattern):")
constraint_summary <- data2 %>%
  filter(Decade == "2021_2030", Pattern == "suitable") %>%
  mutate(
    Marine_Zone_Clean = case_when(
      Marine_Zone == "State Waters" ~ "State Waters",
      Marine_Zone == "Commonwealth Waters" ~ "Commonwealth Waters", 
      Marine_Zone == "High Seas" ~ "High Seas",
      TRUE ~ Marine_Zone
    ),
    # Set the same factor order for consistency
    Marine_Zone_Clean = factor(Marine_Zone_Clean, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
    Total_Area = No_Analog_km2 + Low_Confidence_km2 + Medium_Confidence_km2 + High_Confidence_km2 + Unsuitable_Constraints_km2,
    Constraint_Percent = round((Unsuitable_Constraints_km2 / Total_Area) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  select(Marine_Zone_Clean, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, High_Confidence_km2, Total_Area, Constraint_Percent) %>%
  arrange(Marine_Zone_Clean)

print(constraint_summary)

# Show High Seas summary across all scenarios for context
print("High Seas summary across scenarios (2021-2030):")
high_seas_summary <- data2 %>%

  mutate(
    SSP_clean = case_when(

print(high_seas_summary)
```

#save some of the all confidence analogues with new colors
```{r}
# Load required libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
library(viridis)
library(here)

# Load the CORRECTED results data
area_results <- read.csv(file.path(output_dir, "area_results_marine_zones_with_constraints_CORRECTED.csv"))

# Create output directory for new colored plots
plots_dir_new_colors <- file.path(output_dir, "plots_new_colors")
dir.create(plots_dir_new_colors, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Define the new color scheme
new_colors <- c(
  "High Confidence" = "#2E4C6D",        # Dark blue for high confidence
  "Medium Confidence" = "#35B779FF",     # Viridis green for medium confidence  
  "Low Confidence" = "#31688EFF",        # Viridis blue for low confidence
  "No Analog" = "#FDE725FF",             # Yellow for no analogues
  "Unsuitable (Constraints)" = "#808080" # Grey for constraints
)

# Create a function to generate both area and percentage plots for each SSP-pattern combination
create_combined_plots <- function(area_results, ssp, pattern) {
  
  # Filter and prepare data
  plot_data <- area_results %>%
    filter(SSP == ssp, Pattern == pattern) %>%
    # Clean up marine zone names (they should already be correct now)
    mutate(
      Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas"))
    ) %>%
    # Convert to long format
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
               High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2),
      names_to = "Category",
      values_to = "Area_km2"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Category == "No_Analog_km2" ~ "No Analog",
        Category == "Low_Confidence_km2" ~ "Low Confidence",
        Category == "Medium_Confidence_km2" ~ "Medium Confidence",
        Category == "High_Confidence_km2" ~ "High Confidence",
        Category == "Unsuitable_Constraints_km2" ~ "Unsuitable (Constraints)",
        TRUE ~ Category
      ),
      # Set the order for stacking (bottom to top)
      Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
        "Unsuitable (Constraints)", "No Analog", "Low Confidence", 
        "Medium Confidence", "High Confidence"
      ))
    )
  
  # Clean SSP name for title
  ssp_clean <- case_when(
    ssp == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
    ssp == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
    ssp == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
    ssp == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
    ssp == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
    TRUE ~ ssp
  )
  
  # Create area plot
  p_area <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors, name = "Category") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Area by Climate Suitability and Constraints -", ssp_clean, "-", pattern),
      x = "Time Period",
      y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
      fill = "Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
  
  # Create percentage plot
  p_percentage <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
    facet_wrap(~Marine_Zone) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors, name = "Category") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Percentage by Climate Suitability and Constraints -", ssp_clean, "-", pattern),
      x = "Time Period",
      y = "Percentage",
      fill = "Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 10, face = "bold")
    )
  
  # Combine plots using patchwork
  combined_plot <- p_area / p_percentage +
    plot_layout(guides = "collect") &
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  
  # Save individual plots
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, paste0("area_plot_new_colors_", ssp, "_", pattern, ".png")),
    p_area, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, paste0("percentage_plot_new_colors_", ssp, "_", pattern, ".png")),
    p_percentage, width = 12, height = 8, dpi = 300
  )
  
  # Save combined plot
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, paste0("combined_plot_new_colors_", ssp, "_", pattern, ".png")),
    combined_plot, width = 12, height = 16, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(combined_plot)
}

# Generate plots for all SSP and pattern combinations
ssps <- unique(area_results$SSP)
patterns <- unique(area_results$Pattern)

cat("Creating plots with new color scheme...\n")

for (ssp in ssps) {
  for (pattern in patterns) {
    cat("Processing:", ssp, "-", pattern, "\n")
    combined_plot <- create_combined_plots(area_results, ssp, pattern)
  }
}

# Create a summary comparison plot showing all SSPs for one pattern in a grid
create_summary_comparison <- function(area_results, pattern_type) {
  
  # Prepare data for all SSPs
  summary_data <- area_results %>%
    filter(Pattern == pattern_type) %>%
    mutate(
      Marine_Zone = factor(Marine_Zone, levels = c("State Waters", "Commonwealth Waters", "High Seas")),
      SSP_clean = case_when(
        SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
        SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
        SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
        SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
        SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
        TRUE ~ SSP
      )
    ) %>%
    pivot_longer(
      cols = c(No_Analog_km2, Low_Confidence_km2, Medium_Confidence_km2, 
               High_Confidence_km2, Unsuitable_Constraints_km2),
      names_to = "Category",
      values_to = "Area_km2"
    ) %>%
    mutate(
      Category = case_when(
        Category == "No_Analog_km2" ~ "No Analog",
        Category == "Low_Confidence_km2" ~ "Low Confidence",
        Category == "Medium_Confidence_km2" ~ "Medium Confidence",
        Category == "High_Confidence_km2" ~ "High Confidence",
        Category == "Unsuitable_Constraints_km2" ~ "Unsuitable (Constraints)",
        TRUE ~ Category
      ),
      Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
        "Unsuitable (Constraints)", "No Analog", "Low Confidence", 
        "Medium Confidence", "High Confidence"
      ))
    )
  
  # Create area summary plot
  p_summary_area <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack") +
    facet_grid(Marine_Zone ~ SSP_clean, scales = "free_y") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors, name = "Category") +
    labs(
      title = paste("Area Comparison Across All SSPs -", str_to_title(pattern_type), "Pattern"),
      x = "Time Period",
      y = expression("Area (km"^2*")"),
      fill = "Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
    )
  
  # Create percentage summary plot
  p_summary_percentage <- ggplot(summary_data, aes(x = Decade, y = Area_km2, fill = Category)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "fill") +
    facet_grid(Marine_Zone ~ SSP_clean) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors, name = "Category") +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent_format()) +
    labs(
      title = paste("Percentage Comparison Across All SSPs -", str_to_title(pattern_type), "Pattern"),
      x = "Time Period",
      y = "Percentage",
      fill = "Category"
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1, size = 8),
      legend.position = "bottom",
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
      strip.text = element_text(size = 9, face = "bold")
    )
  
  # Save both summary plots
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, paste0("summary_area_all_SSPs_", pattern_type, "_new_colors.png")),
    p_summary_area, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300
  )
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, paste0("summary_percentage_all_SSPs_", pattern_type, "_new_colors.png")),
    p_summary_percentage, width = 16, height = 12, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(list(area = p_summary_area, percentage = p_summary_percentage))
}

# Create summary plots for both patterns
cat("Creating summary comparison plots...\n")
summary_suitable <- create_summary_comparison(area_results, "suitable")
summary_optimal <- create_summary_comparison(area_results, "optimal")

# Create a color scheme legend for reference
create_color_legend <- function() {
  legend_data <- data.frame(
    Category = names(new_colors),
    Value = 1,
    Description = c(
      "High confidence climate analogues",
      "Medium confidence climate analogues", 
      "Low confidence climate analogues",
      "No climate analogues",
      "Unsuitable due to constraints"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    Category = factor(Category, levels = c(
      "High Confidence", "Medium Confidence", "Low Confidence", 
      "No Analog", "Unsuitable (Constraints)"
    ))
  )
  
  p_legend <- ggplot(legend_data, aes(x = Category, y = Value, fill = Category)) +
    geom_col() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = new_colors, guide = "none") +
    coord_flip() +
    labs(
      title = "Color Scheme Reference",
      subtitle = "New color mapping for marine zone analysis",
      x = "",
      y = ""
    ) +
    theme_minimal() +
    theme(
      axis.text.y = element_text(size = 12),
      axis.text.x = element_blank(),
      axis.ticks = element_blank(),
      panel.grid = element_blank(),
      plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
    ) +
    annotate("text", x = 5, y = 0.5, label = "High confidence\nclimate analogues", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = 4, y = 0.5, label = "Medium confidence\nclimate analogues", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = 3, y = 0.5, label = "Low confidence\nclimate analogues", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = 2, y = 0.5, label = "No climate\nanalogues", size = 3, hjust = 0) +
    annotate("text", x = 1, y = 0.5, label = "Unsuitable due\nto constraints", size = 3, hjust = 0)
  
  ggsave(
    file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, "color_scheme_reference.png"),
    p_legend, width = 8, height = 6, dpi = 300
  )
  
  return(p_legend)
}

# Create the color reference
cat("Creating color scheme reference...\n")
color_legend <- create_color_legend()

# Create an analysis summary
analysis_summary <- area_results %>%
  group_by(SSP, Pattern, Marine_Zone) %>%
  summarise(
    Mean_High_Confidence = mean(High_Confidence_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_Constraints = mean(Unsuitable_Constraints_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Mean_No_Analog = mean(No_Analog_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    SSP_clean = case_when(
      SSP == "ssp119" ~ "SSP1-1.9",
      SSP == "ssp126" ~ "SSP1-2.6",
      SSP == "ssp245" ~ "SSP2-4.5",
      SSP == "ssp370" ~ "SSP3-7.0",
      SSP == "ssp585" ~ "SSP5-8.5",
      TRUE ~ SSP
    )
  )

# Save the analysis summary
write.csv(analysis_summary, 
          file.path(plots_dir_new_colors, "analysis_summary_new_colors.csv"), 
          row.names = FALSE)

cat("All plots created with new color scheme!\n")
cat("Files saved to:", plots_dir_new_colors, "\n")

for(i in 1:length(new_colors)) {
  cat("  ", names(new_colors)[i], ":", new_colors[i], "\n")
}
```
